plainLanguage: Section 143 — Detention in any premises with intent, or in brothel. Ufafanuzi huu unafuata statutory text ya R.E. 2022 bila kubadilisha masharti rasmi.
meaning: Section 143 must be applied from its precise requirements concerning detention, purpose, knowledge, control, warrant procedure or search powers, depending on the subsection.
keyPoints: Read every subsection and paragraph as part of the provision.
Intent, knowledge, control and warrant requirements must be established where expressly required.
Any deeming rule, protection or procedural safeguard in the section must be preserved.

history.summary: Section 143 appears in Chapter XV — Offences Against Morality — Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Verified directly against the government-hosted R.E. 2022 Penal Code.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: The offence or power should be confined to the conditions expressly stated in the provision.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: For search or detention provisions, judicial authorisation, reasonable cause and statutory protections require close attention.

debateQuestion: Je, facts na procedure zinatimiza masharti yote ya section 143?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
